structured_output.analysis:
The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484375 bits per weight. iso_3.15 uses 3.14795, so there is almost no spare room (E514ab09c524e). At the current group size, an int3→int4 upgrade on an MLP layer costs about 1 bit per weight across 3.1M parameters. I have no measured per-layer KL for any layer that would be cheap to downgrade, so funding upgrades with blind downgrades would be guesswork. There are two cheaper routes.

1. Options that cost no bits. act_order=true does not change stored bits.
2. Smaller scale overhead. weight.group_size=256 on the 109 rht_gptq_int3 layers roughly halves their scale cost, from about 0.148 to 0.074 bits per weight. That should free enough bits for a few targeted upgrades.

Three upgrades have large measured single-layer gains:
- 14.down: rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 → rht_gptq_int3 0.00181.
- 27.gate: rht_gptq_int3 0.00499 → rht_gptq_int4 0.00153.
- 3.up: rht_gptq_int3 0.00642 → gptq_int4 0.00238.

proposals.name: iso_actorder
proposals.rationale: This changes options only, so the bit count is the same. Measured KL is 0.436 (E514ab09c524e), above the predicted 0.398, and the GPTQ layers carry most of the loss, e.g. 27.up gptq_int3 at 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded). act_order=true quantizes the high-activation columns first.

proposals.name: rht3_g256_up3
proposals.rationale: Setting weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 roughly halves its scale overhead. The bits freed pay for three upgrades with large measured single-layer gains: 14.down rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to rht_gptq_int3 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645); 27.gate rht_gptq_int3 0.00499 (Efa0bb391da67) to rht_gptq_int4 0.00153 (Ef428ac081334); 3.up rht_gptq_int3 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5) to gptq_int4 0.00238 (Ef4ee8cb4969e).

proposals.name: rht3_g256_up3_actorder
proposals.rationale: This is the same as rht3_g256_up3 plus act_order=true, to offset the extra error from weight.group_size=256. Upgrades: 14.down 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645); 27.gate 0.00499 (Efa0bb391da67) to 0.00153 (Ef428ac081334); 3.up 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5) to 0.00238 (Ef4ee8cb4969e).
